key.name: panel-mode
key.description: Selects how usage appears in the top panel: 'icon', 'compact-pills', or 'full-text'.

key.name: panel-box
key.description: Which GNOME top bar box holds the indicator: 'left', 'center', or 'right'.

key.name: panel-position
key.summary: Position index within the selected top bar box
key.description: Zero-based index inside the chosen panel box.

key.name: auto-hide-when-empty
key.summary: Hide indicator when no active providers are present
key.description: Automatically hides the top bar indicator when zero visible providers are configured or discovered.

key.name: density-mode
key.description: Controls whether the main popover displays 'detailed' multi-bucket cards or 'compact' single-line rows.

key.name: popover-layout
key.description: Selects how provider cards are arranged in the main popover: 'list' (compact single column with top 5 and progressive disclosure), 'auto-grid' (2-column wide layout when 6+ providers are visible), or 'grid' (always 2-column wide layout).

key.name: theme
key.description: Selects one of the 24 curated dark, light, adaptive GNOME system, and frosted Liquid Glass theme presets (for example 'midnight-slate', 'system', 'liquid-glass', 'liquid-glass-light', 'catppuccin-latte', 'tokyo-night', 'catppuccin', 'gruvbox', 'rose-pine', 'nord', or 'everforest') without restricting custom preset IDs.

key.name: font-style
key.description: Selects 'system' tabular UI font or 'monospace' developer font.

key.name: metric-mode
key.description: Controls whether bars and labels display percentage 'used' or percentage 'remaining'.

key.name: keybinding-toggle-popover
key.summary: Global keyboard shortcut to toggle the usage popover
key.description: Optional GNOME Shell accelerator array (such as ['<Super><Shift>a']) that toggles the usage popover globally. Leave empty to disable.

key.name: refresh-interval-seconds
key.description: How often the extension triggers a background status collection when active.

key.name: hidden-providers
key.description: List of canonical provider IDs hidden from the top bar and main popover. Secondary providers are hidden by default so the top 5 (Claude, Codex, Grok, Cursor, Antigravity) appear first.

key.name: binary-path
key.summary: Optional custom path to gnome-agent-status binary
key.description: Overrides automatic binary discovery when non-empty.

key.name: provider-order
key.description: Ordered list of canonical provider IDs controlling top bar pills, text summaries, and main popover cards.

key.name: notify-on-warning
key.summary: Notify when a provider crosses the 80% warning threshold
key.description: Sends a desktop notification once per quota window when an active provider reaches 80% used.

key.name: notify-on-critical
key.summary: Notify when a provider crosses the 90% critical threshold
key.description: Sends an urgent desktop notification once per quota window when an active provider reaches 90% used.

key.name: notify-on-reset
key.summary: Notify when a high-usage quota window resets
key.description: Sends a desktop notification when a previously high-usage primary bucket resets back to fresh capacity.
